source_type: Regulatory filings, official government investigation reports, SEC litigation releases

tier_a: SEC Litigation Release No. 17197 — enforcement action against Enron
SEC Press Release 2001-158 — contemporaneous regulatory action
U.S. Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations report on Enron board failure (GPO-CPRT-107SPRT80393)
tier_b: Credible academic case studies on Enron governance and accounting failure
Established financial journalism covering the collapse and its regulatory aftermath

contamination_notes: Almost all primary sources are retrospective and post-collapse. Fraud conclusions, bankruptcy filing facts, Arthur Andersen collapse, and criminal conviction outcomes must not appear in input.json. Input must be restricted to observable pre-collapse warning signals as of August 14, 2001.
source_limitations: Primary sources are retrospective; none were produced at the August 2001 decision date
Fraud conclusion is established only in outcome materials, not in input
Arthur Andersen collapse is post-decision and must remain in outcome only
Criminal conviction details are post-decision and must remain in outcome only
Final restatement figures are post-decision and excluded from input
